LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Enlist_Letter_Label:
You've been vetted, and the Protector has signed off. Understand this: we don't hand out charity and we don't apologize for what we are. Technology comes first, always. If that doesn't sit right with you, walk away now.

You'll draw a standard salary every week for you and your team, along with provisions collected at our camps when you're not out in the field. We're few, but we're not soft.

 -Ad Victoriam
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Enlist_Button_Desc: Sign a new contract with the {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Satis: You need a minimum of 10 goodwill; currently you have only {0} goodwill.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Missions_Desc: Take on tasks for the {FACTION_name}. Completing a task earns you a bounty reward.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Menu_Missions_Desc: While leaving the camp you ask around about any potential tasks that need doing.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Salary_Desc: You are entitled to collect wages from this faction every 14 days.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Provisions_Desc: Provisions will arrive via your caravan inventory every 10 days:\n\n- ×5 BoS Food Crate
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Provisions_Desc_Standard_Iss:
Outcast standard issue gear will arrive via your caravan inventory every 45 days:

- ×2 BoS Standard Weapon Crate
- ×2 BoS Standard Tech Resource Crate
- ×2 Outcast Uniform Crate
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Storage_Desc: Store items from your caravan to your faction stash. Faction stashes transfer across all of the faction's outposts and will save contents even if you are no longer enlisted.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Part_Time_Job_Desc: Pull additional duties around camp for 10 silver an hour.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Hospital_Desc: Check in with the camp's hospital. This service tends to all of your team with industrial medicine. Immunity gain is also increased while your team is in the hospital.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Defender_Training_Desc:
Train with the Outcasts' fortified camp defenders, with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Shooting
- Melee

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Recon_Training_Desc:
Train scouting and salvage analysis alongside the Outcasts' Recon Specialists, with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Intellectual
- Shooting

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Turn_In_Desc: Turn in war prisoners and high value targets to Outcast camps.\n\n -Turning over any hostile pawns does not result in a slavery debuff-
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Resign_Menu_Text: You will resign from the {FACTION_name} effective immediately. (-25 in relations)
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Resign_Button_Label: You have successfully resigned from the {FACTION_name}. (-25 relations)
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Faction: cannot join because you are enlisted with their enemy, {HOSTILEFACTION_name}
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Kick_Out_Label_Title: An order for your contract's immediate termination from service has been filed by {LEADER_nameDef}. You have been kicked out from the {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.FCP_Outcast_Reinforcements_Button_Desc: Call for reinforcements from your faction. The number of Defenders and Specialists they send depends on your current relations.
